newsitem.title: NORWAY: Amerada make interesting North Sea find.
newsitem.headline: Amerada make interesting North Sea find.

text.p: Amerada Hess, as operator of licence 189 covering blocks 25/8 and 25/9 in the North Sea, has found hydrocarbons in the area following the completion of exploration well 25/8-9, the Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) said on Monday.
The well, drilled to a depth of 2,515 metres below sea level, was located just east of the Jotun discovery. Hydrocarbons were found but the well was not production tested, the OD said.
It said it considered the results of the drilling interesting but added that further exploration in the area could prove difficult.

Partners in licence 189 are Amerada Hess with 20 percent, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 70 percent -- including 45 percent of the state's direct interest -- and Saga Petroleum ASA with 10 percent.
